decision.explanation: The documents describe three distinct individuals named Kevin Lewis who were footballers, each with a different birth date: one born in 1940 (Sheffield United/Liverpool), one born in 1952 (Stoke City/Crewe Alexandra), and one born in 1970 (Stoke City). Document d01 contains a conflicting date of 1950 for the 1940-born player, which is inconsistent with the explicit title 'born 1940' and the career timeline provided in d00, so it is rejected as an error.
